targets.rawSQL: SELECT AVG(fill_rate) * 100 AS fill_rate_pct FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary)
SELECT AVG(cancel_rate) * 100 AS cancel_rate_pct FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary)
SELECT SUM(total_orders) AS total_orders FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary)
SELECT AVG(avg_fill_delay_sec) AS avg_fill_delay_sec FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary)

SELECT summary_hour AS time, fill_rate * 100 AS fill_rate_pct, cancel_rate * 100 AS cancel_rate_pct FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour

SELECT summary_hour AS time, total_orders, filled_orders, canceled_orders FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour

SELECT summary_hour AS time, CAST(total_order_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_order_qty, CAST(total_filled_qty AS DOUBLE) AS total_filled_qty FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour

SELECT summary_hour, symbol, total_orders, filled_orders, canceled_orders, fill_rate, cancel_rate, avg_fill_delay_sec, avg_order_qty, avg_filled_qty, total_order_qty, total_filled_qty, benchmark_vwap, avg_buy_fill_price, avg_sell_fill_price, buy_slippage_bps, sell_slippage_bps, slippage_cost_quote, updated_at FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Slippage vs VWAP (bps) — Buy / Sell
panels.description: 양수 = 벤치마크(VWAP) 대비 유리. 방향 분리(부호 상쇄 방지). 0 주변으로 퇴화하지 않고 변동성과 상관하면 anchor≠benchmark 가 지켜진 것.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT summary_hour AS time, buy_slippage_bps, sell_slippage_bps FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour

panels.title: Slippage Cost (quote)
panels.description: Σ filled_qty × 방향보정 가격차. 양수 = 순유리(절감), 음수 = 순비용.

targets.rawSQL: SELECT summary_hour AS time, CAST(slippage_cost_quote AS DOUBLE) AS slippage_cost_quote FROM order_execution_summary WHERE summary_hour >= (SELECT MAX(summary_hour) - INTERVAL '30' DAY FROM order_execution_summary) ORDER BY summary_hour
